comment: Stage-1 cost calibration (R16/R18): x=0.6 (cheap end) and 0.5182 (near SRI, most expensive in the baseline); full window ladder to L14 with nz16; one array per thread count. L16 is NOT here: after this campaign and the setup probe finish, fill calibration_L16.template.json from the measured L14 RSS/time and the L16 probe and freeze it as a separate continuation campaign. Memory sized from the setup probe (job 54739261: L14 setup peak 0.45 GiB, L16 2.0 GiB): 8G/4 cores and 16G/8 cores, so memory never sets the charge (Expanse SU/h = max(cpus, GB/2)).
